info.name: Vendor Service
info.description:
Complete Postman Collection (v2.1) for the Beauty on Wheels Vendor Service API.

Generated from the OpenAPI/Swagger specification (`swagger/swagger.js`).

**Suggested flow**
1. Create Vendor → stores `vendorId`
2. Update Vendor Lifecycle Status → ACTIVE
3. Add Service Area → stores `serviceAreaId`
4. Replace Operating Hours
5. Add Staff → stores `staffId`
6. Replace Capabilities
7. Get / Update nested resources
8. Delete Staff / Service Area when cleaning up

Path parameters use collection/environment variables (`{{vendorId}}`, `{{serviceAreaId}}`, `{{staffId}}`).
